content: Timothy bǝl ki Bulus kal isi Silas
Bulus mbǝ a Dalba nǝ a Listila. Mul kushti wonɗa mul shin Timothy, dyawasi mul Yehudiya ni, ti mul bǝtl Yesu kal kǝnǝ amma bwasi mul Helinawa ni.
Mi' bǝtl Yesu kal ki Listila nǝ ki Ikoniya si dlǝb zo' shilǝn tǝnti.
Bulus ɗǝ lyamti sǝ' zǝga siti, is zǝga siti i' sǝlti ɗa gaki Yahudawa yi nǝɗǝ dǝb a lǝbi u, mus simani bwasi mul Helinawani.
Nǝsi bǝtl gatl nǝ gatl tya u, is gob dlimi' mbalǝn zhilu nǝ mi'kina ne' kolso ki Ikilisiya kǝndǝ a Ulshelima u, gaki tǝ mbalǝn shindǝl ga ɗa.
Nǝnǝgu i mi'bǝtl Yesu kal ndǝndǝl ge' la'ti mbadlwasǝn ɗa, hu gasi ukǝni si mbil tǝnki.
Tlu'ti ki Bulus tǝn mul ki Makidoniya
Bulus nǝ mbalǝnwasi is gadǝl atl ki Pilijiya nǝ Galatiya, gaki Yal ki mbatl ki Lya a ndǝgisi i sǝ'dlǝm shilǝn ki mulban age' atl ki Asiya wai.
Nǝsbǝ tǝn bisi ki atl ki Misiya u, is lyami sǝttege' atl ki Bitiniya, amma Yal ki mbatl ki Yesu a ndǝgisiwai.
Is bǝli malgǝn Misiya, is ɓeu swa Talwasa.
A gasi i Bulus tlu ki tǝn mul Makidoniya tikǝ dlǝlli ti ngepti, “Mbǝ a Makidoniya ki ɗǝlmi.”
Kal ki tlu'ti ki Bulus, in hilya ɗǝ lǝ' Makidoniya, ma mani i Lya kǝn taki mibi tǝn dlimisi shǝlǝn wasi.
Lidiya ta Ndǝnǝ Lya i
In hilya ɗǝ Taluwasa in tege' kundǝlǝn ki mal illǝ tya Samutalas, lucili illǝ Niyabolis.
Te' lǝbi in zǝga tya Pilibi, gatlu nǝ Lomawa pǝlisi gunti bal gatl kǝnǝ Macidoniya. Illǝm mutti tyaka.
Gas cin shuti in pe' abidlabi gatli in su dlǝlka, ge'lu' u nǝmi la'ti mbadli mǝn mbi' lu shilǝn nǝ Lya u. In dǝm atli in gob dlǝmi' mudlǝ i nǝ domga lǝbi i shilǝn.
Nǝm ge' mi'gaki'mi kǝm kǝli ki ge' gatl ki Tayatila mul shin Lidiya, mul utl gou lulut taka, mul bǝtl Lya kǝni. I Lya ɓul mbadlwasi i' ga'kǝm tǝn shilǝn ki Bulus.
Kal ki pǝli' kǝliyi baptisma ne' mi' libiwasu, im mbemi bi a libi ɗa'ka. I' usu “Ən ka ndǝ' ni ami mul bǝtl Lya kal kǝn u,” “Nganni ki' dǝmni libi ɗaka.” I' shelmi.
Kǝndǝ Mi'kina a Ge'lu Kǝnd Mbalǝn ki Pilibi
Gason mi zǝ'ga ge'lu shilǝn nǝ Lya, in ma ne' zheli yakǝn kǝli mul yallu, ti domi' mulbanwas lǝɓa nǝ yalluwasu.
Ibbǝl Bulus kal ne' mi, a ti la'ti Yal, “Mbalǝn gi mi' ki Lya kǝni, si dlimi' kin shitu ki pe'ti.”
Ip pǝtl gu mutti diɓǝli. Il le'ci Bulus lo'si i' yalu kal i' ul mul yallu isu, “Ge' shin ki Yesu ami bǝtl ki zhil pe' ɗǝge'ti!” Alǝbi i mi'gatli za'ti.
Nǝ mulban yeni shitu mbi' ulpwasǝn a caku, is gob Bulus nǝ Sila is dǝlsi swa bi lu dobga ki utl lǝɓa taka akina ɗǝ mi' pǝtl shilǝn.
Is tǝlasi kina ɗǝ mi'pǝtl shilǝn is usu, “Mbalǝngi Yahudawani, ko animi si tlǝli'mi gatl lya.
Si kulci' mi shilǝn u nǝ bǝ ambuni tǝn bǝliwai u tǝngaki mi Lomawa ni.”
I hwu mbalǝn dopga tǝn ki Bulus isǝ Silas, i mul pǝtl shilǝni laki tǝ tusisi lu' lǝgǝl a li'si nǝ kumbǝl ki dom.
Kal ki li'tisi iye, is la'si age'lu kǝndǝ' mbalǝn, i la'mul kǝndǝ' mbalǝni tǝp ɓu'si ki zoki.
Nǝ' kan zhilu u, is sulsi swa giɓi i' ki ndǝsi tǝn ancin ki ngapti asǝn.
Age' dlom gasi Bulus nǝ silas si shilǝn nǝ Lya asi utl ul ki natl Lya, nami' ki ge'lu kǝndǝ mbalǝn ɗǝ gakisi kǝm.
Nǝgu katl, i pǝl bal ukkǝ atli sai nǝ gǝsbi ki lu kǝndǝ mbalǝni uni. Alǝbi alǝbi i dlabi ki lu kǝndǝ mbalǝni ɓuli, i mus zhim dom ki kǝndǝ mi'ki kǝndǝyi ɓaɓatli.
Nǝ mul kǝndǝ' mbalǝni hilya u, nǝ' en dlabi ni ki ɓuli u, ittus bal pǝga tǝtl tlogawasi, gaki ti yenti mi'kǝ kǝndǝ i sa kitǝli.
I Bulus tlǝl Yal i usu, “Bǝ kumi gawa'! Ciwowai musinǝn miɗa!”
I mul kǝndǝ mbalǝni ta' bi tǝ mbǝlli' cilti, is su giɓi in nda kina ɗǝ Bulus nǝ Silas nǝ nepti ki dli.
I ki ippekkǝlsi totldla i' usu, “Mi'kina, ya tapǝli ta mbi pe'ti ɗa u?”
Is ndǝgi, “La'mbatl nǝ Yesu, kǝn mbi' pe'ti ki nǝ libiwagi.”
Iki is dlǝmi' shilǝn ki Lya ti mus ne' mi'libi wasi.
Age' gasu imul kǝndǝ mballǝni yemsi i' okkǝlisi usuwasǝn taka; Alǝbi ti mus ne' libiwasi i pǝlisi baptisma.
Im mbǝlsi libi ɗakka im mbǝllisi ulki ɗami; in njǝkǝn nǝ hwol mbadli gaki ta la'mbatl nǝ Lya i mus nǝ mi' libiwasi.
Nǝlu cilu, i mi' pǝtl shilǝni shin mil shinkǝn ki guu, summa mul kǝndǝ mbalǝni nǝ zhil: “Tǝ za' mbalǝn i.”
I mul kǝndǝ' mbalǝni ul Bulus su, “Mi'pǝtl shilǝn a bil zhili ki tǝ zakkini ki zǝnga. Nǝ guni kǝn ma'zǝgga. Zǝnga nǝ hwol tugi.”
Amma i Bulus ul mi'kina i su: “Age' mbalǝn kǝn sǝ li'mi bǝma pǝlisi ulǝnwai, mus nǝ mima Lomawa u, is la'mi ge'lu kǝndǝ mbalǝn. Nǝgun si lyap pe'kǝtl mi shota? Hwe sǝm mbǝ nǝgawasǝn sǝppekkǝlmi.
I mi' kǝndǝ dlom mi dlimi mi'pǝtl shilǝni, nǝs kumi Bulus nǝ Silas mi' Lomawa u, is kum ɓanti.
Is mbǝ ɗǝ ngep pashti ma'si, is pekǝlsi ɗǝ ge'lu kǝndǝ mbalǝni, ɗǝ ngepsi sǝ'za'gatli.
Kalki pe'ti ki Bulus nǝ Silas ɗǝge' lu kǝndǝ mbalǝn u, is lǝ libi ɗǝ Lidiya, lu unǝs ma ne' yelsǝni mil bǝtl Lya mwani nǝ mudli is ndillisi mbadli. Is zǝga.
